EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT
Office of Ilauning and Iudget
270 WASHINGTON ST., S.W. ATLANTA, GA. 30334
TOM LINDER, JR. DIRECTOR
July 31, 1972
PCK
The Honorable Rogers C. B. Morton Secretary of the Interior United States Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Secretary:
In fulfillment of a request made in your memorandum regarding the Implementation of Executive Order 11644, the Georgia State Clearinghouse has coordinated a review of the Draft Environmental Statement pertaining to the use of Off-Road-Vehicles on public lands.
The review of this statement was conducted by the Georgia Department of Natural Resources, Game and Fish Division, which is the regulatory agency for allied activities in Georgia.
Inasmuch as the Division's comments are relatively lengthy, they will not be summarized herein. Those comments are, however, attached in verbatim format.
The State Clearinghouse appreciated the opportunity to review and comment on the implementation of this Executive Order.
Sincerely,
John Robins
State Clearinghouse
